subject: Offer exception request: Emily Zhao — OOB comp, equity refresh, sign-on
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 4 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Offer exceptions for Emily Zhao (SWE L6)

Hi Hannah —

Following up on our interview loop for Emily Zhao (final interview last week). Hiring manager ask below; we need OOB approval before we can send a competitive offer — candidate has a competing deadline of 2026-05-07 COB.

Summary:
- Role: Senior Software Engineer (L6) — Backend/Infra focus
- Proposed comp (packaged): base $260,000 + 20% RSU refresh (one-time grant) + $30,000 sign-on
- Current L6 band: base 170k–230k, standard equity refresh not typical at hire, sign-on typically $0–10k
- Reason for exception: highly specialized infra experience, immediate product impact (systems we need live in Q3), and counteroffer from a stealth infra startup at $255k + 1.5% eq.

Ask:
1) Approve out-of-band base to $260k (above band by $30k) OR authorize exe approval route if needed
2) Approve one-time equity refresh (~20% of annual target RSU grant as a bridge)
3) Approve $30k sign-on to neutralize candidate counteroffer

Attachments: offer_packet_emily_zhao_v1.pdf (PDF), comp-band-l6.csv (CSV)

Rationale:
- Candidate has previous large-scale infra design + production SLA ownership at scale; immediate ramp expected to <6 weeks; hiring backfill risk if we lose candidate.
- Market comps (see attached) put total comp target for similarly scoped roles at ~260–290k base-equivalent in West Coast markets.

If we can get a quick green light on at least sign-on + equity refresh I can get the offer over today and request exec signoff for base >245k if necessary.

Thanks — Vivek

--
Vivek Kulkarni
Director, Platform Engineering
Redwood Inference
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 4 May 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Offer exceptions for Emily Zhao (SWE L6)

Vivek —

Thanks for the quick summary. A couple quick asks before I escalate:
- Please confirm this hire is approved headcount for Q2 (ticket HR-3245) and not an add-on; I need the headcount confirmation to authorize any comp above band.
- Provide a short candidate justification (2–3 bullets) tying immediate deliverables to revenue/ops impact.
- Can you also attach the market comps or notes from the interview loop that justify the equity refresh?

If headcount is approved and the justification checks out, I can approve a partial exception (sign-on + equity refresh) today and route base >245k to exec.

— Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Sr. Manager, Talent Acquisition
Redwood Inference
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 4 May 2026 11:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Offer exceptions for Emily Zhao (SWE L6)

On Mon, May 4, 2026 at 10:05 AM Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com> wrote:
> Vivek —
>
> Thanks for the quick summary. A couple quick asks before I escalate:
> - Please confirm this hire is approved headcount for Q2 (ticket HR-3245) and not an add-on; I need the headcount confirmation to authorize any comp above band.
> - Provide a short candidate justification (2–3 bullets) tying immediate deliverables to revenue/ops impact.
> - Can you also attach the market comps or notes from the interview loop that justify the equity refresh?

Thanks — adding details below and attaching the comp analysis.

Headcount: confirmed — this is an approved Q2 backfill (HR-3245).

Candidate justification (brief):
- Replaces an original L6 role (backfill) and will own the KV cache/replication subsystem that directly supports our Hosted inference SLA for enterprise customers.
- Candidate has prior experience reducing tail latency by 25% at scale; expected to reduce infra costs by optimizing KV cache size & IO patterns in the next two quarters (measurable ops savings).
- Interview feedback: unanimous green across loop; stretch technical design demonstrated.

Market/comp notes attached (market-banding-summary.pdf, comp_analysis_emily.xlsx). Highlights: total comp for similar hires in region is elevated; chief differentiator is immediate availability and domain-specific experience.

If Hannah approves sign-on + equity refresh I will prepare offer paperwork for immediate send and route base >245k to exec for sign-off.

Thanks — Vivek
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 5 May 2026 08:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Offer exceptions for Emily Zhao (SWE L6)

Hannah / Vivek —

Thanks for the context and the attachments. I reviewed the comp analysis and interview notes. Given the candidate quality and time sensitivity I am comfortable approving the following immediately:

- Sign-on: $20,000 (one-time)
- Equity refresh: one-time RSU top-up equal to ~12% of annual target grant (vesting per our standard schedule)

I am not comfortable approving base above $245k from TA alone. For base >$245k, I will route to execs (CTO + CFO) — please prepare a 1-page exec justification (impact, counteroffer details, ramp plan) and tag it for urgent review.

Markus — can you confirm budget availability for $245k + $20k sign-on + the equity top-up? If finance confirms, Hannah you can issue the offer at those levels while we await exec decision on base top-up.

— Laura
Laura Bennett
VP, People & Talent
Redwood Inference
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 6 May 2026 14:50:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Offer exceptions for Emily Zhao (SWE L6)

Laura / Hannah / Vivek —

Confirmed: finance has capacity within the hiring pool to support a base up to $245,000, a $20,000 sign-on, and the one-time equity top-up as described. Please route the offer through the standard approval chain and include the exec justification if you plan to request base >245k.

Action items:
- Vivek: update offer_packet_emily_zhao_v2.pdf to reflect base $245k, $20k sign-on, and equity top-up; attach hiring_commitment_form and the comp_analysis summary.
- Hannah: you may extend the offer at those levels today; if Vivek wants to pursue the additional $15k base, escalate with the 1-pager to CTO/CFO immediately (cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com).

I'll also add a quick finance approval note to HR-3245.

Thanks — Markus
Markus Klein
Director, Finance Operations
Redwood Inference
